name: Coamo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and black.
history: Coamo is a town and municipality in south-central Puerto Rico, founded in 1579. The flag takes its colours from the coat of arms — red, yellow and black, the black for the sorrows and mourning suffered by Coamo; flag and arms were adopted on 5 August 1969, according to Flags of the World.
